blocks.text: Serverless architectures mein developers servers sambhale baghair applications banate aur deploy karte hain; is se scalability barhti aur operational complexity (chalane ki uljhan) kam hoti hai. Serverless model mein cloud provider zaroorat ke mutabiq resources khud provide karta hai, aur developers sirf utne computing resources ki qeemat dete hain jitne asal mein istemal hue. ('Serverless' ka matlab yeh nahi ke server hote hi nahi; server hote hain magar unhein provider sambhalta hai.)

Misal (Example): Amazon Web Services (AWS) Lambda ek serverless computing service hai jis mein developers servers tayyar (provision) ya manage kiye baghair code chalate hain. Is se developers infrastructure sambhalne ki bajaye code likhne aur applications banane par dhyan dete hain.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Amazing Fact: serverless architectures mein aap ki application demand ke mutabiq khud ba khud barhti ghatti hai, is liye aap sirf utne resources istemal karte aur un ki qeemat dete hain jitne chahiye!

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa service model developers ko servers manage kiye baghair applications banane aur deploy karne deta hai (exercise MCQ 9)? Serverless architectures ka main faida kya hai (MCQ 11)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 9: (d) Serverless Architecture. MCQ 11: (a) cost savings (kharche ki bachat).

blocks.prompt: Serverless architectures ka concept (khayal), developers ke liye un ke faide, aur application development par un ka asar bataiye (exercise short questions 4 aur 7; long question 5).
blocks.explanation: Serverless mein developer sirf apna code (chhote functions) provider ko deta hai; provider use zaroorat par chalata aur resources khud provide karta hai. Faide: servers set up, update ya barhane ki zaroorat nahi; demand ke saath automatic scaling; sirf asal istemal ki payment; is liye developers infrastructure ki bajaye code aur features par waqt lagate hain aur apps jaldi bante hain. Misal: AWS Lambda.

items: Serverless: servers provider sambhalta hai; developer sirf code likhta hai.
Automatic scaling; sirf asal istemal ki payment (AWS Lambda).
